license_required.quote: No person shall sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state unless the person is licensed for that line of authority in accordance with this chapter.

issuing_authority.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a resident insurance agent license to an individual applicant whose home state is Ohio

name.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a resident insurance agent license to an individual applicant whose home state is Ohio

type.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a resident insurance agent license to an individual applicant whose home state is Ohio

umbrella_agency.quote: Any costs collected shall be paid into the state treasury to the credit of the department of insurance operating fund

age_minimum.quote: The applicant is at least eighteen years of age.

moral_character_required.quote: The applicant is honest and trustworthy and is otherwise suitable to be licensed.

degree_required.value: bachelor's or associate's degree in insurance, or a professional designation approved by the superintendent, or 20 hours of approved pre-exam education
degree_required.quote: The individual has earned a bachelor's or associate's degree in insurance from an accredited institution. ... The individual has earned a professional designation approved by the superintendent. ... The individual has completed, for each line of authority for which the individual has applied, twenty hours of study in a program of insurance education approved by the superintendent

accrediting_body.value: accredited institution (for degree); superintendent-approved programs (for pre-exam education)
accrediting_body.quote: The individual has earned a bachelor's or associate's degree in insurance from an accredited institution.

degree_level.quote: The individual has completed, for each line of authority for which the individual has applied, twenty hours of study in a program of insurance education approved by the superintendent

school_approval_basis.quote: twenty hours of study in a program of insurance education approved by the superintendent

credential_pegged.quote: The individual has earned a bachelor's or associate's degree in insurance from an accredited institution.

required.quote: No person shall sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state unless the person is licensed for that line of authority in accordance with this chapter.

experience_source.quote: No person shall sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state unless the person is licensed for that line of authority in accordance with this chapter.

exams.name: Written examination for insurance agent license
exams.notes: Required for life, accident and health, property, casualty, personal lines, title, surety bail bonds, and other designated lines. Not required for limited lines travel insurance or certain exempted limited lines. Pre-exam education also required unless the applicant holds a qualifying degree or designation.
exams.jurisdiction: state (administered by or under contract with superintendent of insurance)
exams.quote: a resident individual applying for an insurance agent license for any of the lines of authority described in division (B) of this section shall take and pass a written examination prior to application for licensure

exams.name: FINRA Series 6, 7, 63, 66, or other approved FINRA examination
exams.notes: Required only for variable life-variable annuity line of authority; applicant must also be registered with FINRA as a registered representative.
exams.quote: Any applicant applying for variable life-variable annuity line of authority is registered with the financial industry regulatory authority (FINRA) as a registered representative after having passed at least one of the following examinations administered by the FINRA: the series 6 examination, the series 7 examination, the series 63 examination, the series 66 examination, or any other FINRA examination approved by the superintendent.

interval_years.quote: An individual seeking to renew a resident insurance agent license shall apply biennially for a renewal of the license on or before the last day of the licensee's birth month.

required.quote: Each individual who is issued a resident insurance agent license shall complete at least twenty-four hours of continuing education for each license renewal period.

hours_per_period.quote: Each individual who is issued a resident insurance agent license shall complete at least twenty-four hours of continuing education for each license renewal period.

period_years.quote: An individual seeking to renew a resident insurance agent license shall apply biennially for a renewal of the license

topical_requirements.quote: The continuing education shall be offered in a course or program of study approved by the superintendent of insurance and shall include at least three hours of approved ethics training.

available.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall waive all requirements under this chapter for a nonresident applicant with a valid license from the applicant's home state, except the requirements set forth in sections 3905.07 to 3905.072 of the Revised Code, if the applicant's home state awards nonresident agent licenses to residents of this state on the same basis.

requirements.value: Nonresident applicant must hold a valid resident license in their home state and be in good standing. Home state must award nonresident licenses to Ohio residents on the same basis. Applicant must submit the home state application or NAIC uniform application and pay applicable fees. No pre-licensing education or examination required if currently licensed in another state in good standing.
requirements.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a nonresident insurance agent license to an applicant that is a nonresident person upon payment of all applicable fees required under this chapter if the superintendent finds all of the following: (1) The applicant is currently licensed as a resident and is in good standing in the applicant's home state.

exists.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a resident insurance agent license to an individual applicant whose home state is Ohio upon submission of a completed application and payment of any applicable fee required under this chapter

national_association.quote: "NAIC" means the national association of insurance commissioners.

regulatory_model.quote: No person shall sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state unless the person is licensed for that line of authority in accordance with this chapter.

credential_type.quote: "License" means the authority issued by the superintendent to a person to act as an insurance agent for the lines of authority specified

is_mandatory.quote: No person shall sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state unless the person is licensed for that line of authority in accordance with this chapter.

title_protection.quote: No agent other than an independent insurance agent shall represent self, or shall be represented, to the public as an independent insurance agent or agency.

scope_protection.quote: No person shall sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance in this state unless the person is licensed for that line of authority in accordance with this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially untrue information in a license or appointment application.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Providing incorrect, misleading, incomplete, or materially untrue information in a license or appointment application;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or failing to comply with any insurance law, rule, subpoena, consent agreement, or order of the superintendent or of the insurance authority of another state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violating or failing to comply with any insurance law, rule, subpoena, consent agreement, or order of the superintendent or of the insurance authority of another state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining, maintaining, or attempting to obtain or maintain a license through misrepresentation or fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining, maintaining, or attempting to obtain or maintain a license through misrepresentation or fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly withholding, misappropriating, or converting any money or property received in the course of doing insurance business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly withholding, misappropriating, or converting any money or property received in the course of doing insurance business;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentionally misrepresenting the terms, benefits, value, cost, or effective dates of any actual or proposed insurance contract or application for insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Intentionally misrepresenting the terms, benefits, value, cost, or effective dates of any actual or proposed insurance contract or application for insurance;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been convicted of or pleaded guilty or no contest to a felony regardless of whether a judgment of conviction has been entered by the court.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been convicted of or pleaded guilty or no contest to a felony regardless of whether a judgment of conviction has been entered by the court;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been convicted of or pleaded guilty or no contest to a misdemeanor involving misuse or theft of money, fraud, forgery, dishonest acts, breach of fiduciary duty, or related to insurance/securities/financial services, or moral turpitude.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been convicted of or pleaded guilty or no contest to a misdemeanor that involves the misuse or theft of money or property belonging to another, fraud, forgery, dishonest acts, or breach of a fiduciary duty, that is based on any act or omission relating to the business of insurance, securities, or financial services, or that involves moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having admitted to committing, or having been found to have committed, any insurance unfair trade act or practice or insurance fraud.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having admitted to committing, or having been found to have committed, any insurance unfair trade act or practice or insurance fraud;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility, in the conduct of business.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using fraudulent, coercive, or dishonest practices, or demonstrating incompetence, untrustworthiness, or financial irresponsibility, in the conduct of business in this state or elsewhere;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having an insurance agent license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended, or revoked in any other state, province, district, or territory.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having an insurance agent license, or its equivalent, denied, suspended, or revoked in any other state, province, district, or territory;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Forging or causing the forgery of an application for insurance or any document related to or used in an insurance transaction.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Forging or causing the forgery of an application for insurance or any document related to or used in an insurance transaction;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Improperly using notes, any other reference material, equipment, or devices of any kind to complete an examination for an insurance agent license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Improperly using notes, any other reference material, equipment, or devices of any kind to complete an examination for an insurance agent license;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly accepting insurance business from an individual who is not licensed.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly accepting insurance business from an individual who is not licensed;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to comply with any official invoice, notice, assessment, or order directing payment of federal, state, or local income tax, state or local sales tax, or workers' compensation premiums.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to comply with any official invoice, notice, assessment, or order directing payment of federal, state, or local income tax, state or local sales tax, or workers' compensation premiums;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to timely submit an application for insurance.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to timely submit an application for insurance.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to disclose to an applicant for insurance or policyholder upon accepting a premium or order to bind coverage that the person has not been appointed by the insurer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to disclose to an applicant for insurance or policyholder upon accepting a premium or an order to bind coverage from the applicant or policyholder, that the person has not been appointed by the insurer;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having any professional license or financial industry regulatory authority registration suspended or revoked or having been barred from participation in any industry.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having any professional license or financial industry regulatory authority registration suspended or revoked or having been barred from participation in any industry;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Having been subject to a cease and desist order or permanent injunction related to mishandling of funds, breach of fiduciary responsibilities, or unlicensed or unregistered activities.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Having been subject to a cease and desist order or permanent injunction related to mishandling of funds or breach of fiduciary responsibilities or for unlicensed or unregistered activities;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Causing or permitting a policyholder to designate the agent or the agent's close relatives as beneficiary of a policy or annuity sold by the agent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Causing or permitting a policyholder or applicant for insurance to designate the insurance agent or the insurance agent's spouse, parent, child, or sibling as the beneficiary of a policy or annuity sold by the insurance agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Causing or permitting a policyholder to designate the agent or the agent's close relatives as owner or beneficiary of a trust funded by a policy or annuity sold by the agent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Causing or permitting a policyholder or applicant for insurance to designate the insurance agent or the insurance agent's spouse, parent, child, or sibling as the owner or beneficiary of a trust funded, in whole or in part, by a policy or annuity sold by the insurance agent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide a written response to the department of insurance within twenty-one calendar days after receipt of any written inquiry from the department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide a written response to the department of insurance within twenty-one calendar days after receipt of any written inquiry from the department, unless a reasonable extension of time has been requested of, and granted by, the superintendent

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to appear to answer questions before the superintendent after being notified in writing of a scheduled interview.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to appear to answer questions before the superintendent after being notified in writing by the superintendent of a scheduled interview

disciplinary_grounds.description: Transferring or placing insurance with an insurer other than the insurer expressly chosen by the applicant without consent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Transferring or placing insurance with an insurer other than the insurer expressly chosen by the applicant for insurance or policyholder without the consent of the applicant or policyholder or absent extenuating circumstances;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to inform a policyholder or applicant of the identity of the insurer or other agents involved upon binding of coverage.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to inform a policyholder or applicant for insurance of the identity of the insurer or insurers, or the identity of any other insurance agent or licensee known to be involved in procuring, placing, or continuing the insurance for the policyholder or applicant, upon the binding of the coverage;

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the case of a business entity agent, failing to report an individual licensee's known violation to the department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of an agent that is a business entity, failing to report an individual licensee's violation to the department when the violation was known or should have been known by one or more of the partners, officers, managers, or members of the business entity;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Submitting or using a document in the conduct of insurance business when the person knew or should have known it contained a forged writing.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Submitting or using a document in the conduct of the business of insurance when the person knew or should have known that the document contained a writing that was forged as defined in section 2913.01 of the Revised Code;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Misrepresenting the person's qualifications, status, or relationship to another person, agency, or entity, or using a professional designation not conferred.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Misrepresenting the person's qualifications, status or relationship to another person, agency, or entity, or using in any way a professional designation that has not been conferred upon the person by the appropriate accrediting organization;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining a premium loan or policy surrender without the insured's knowledge and written authorization.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Obtaining a premium loan or policy surrender or causing a premium loan or policy surrender to be made to or in the name of an insured or policyholder without that person's knowledge and written authorization;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using paper, software, or materials provided by an insurer after the insurer has terminated the licensee's authority.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using paper, software, or any other materials of or provided by an insurer after the insurer has terminated the authority of the licensee, if the use of such materials would cause a reasonable person to believe that the licensee was acting on behalf of or otherwise representing the insurer;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, procuring an application for, or placing any insurance policy when the person is not authorized under this chapter to engage in such activity.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, procuring an application for, or placing, either directly or indirectly, any insurance policy when the person is not authorized under this chapter to engage in such activity;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Soliciting, selling, or negotiating any product offering insurance-like benefits without fully disclosing it is not insurance and not regulated by the superintendent.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Soliciting, selling, or negotiating any product or service that offers benefits similar to insurance but is not regulated by the superintendent, without fully disclosing, orally and in writing, to the prospective purchaser that the product or service is not insurance and is not regulated by the superintendent;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to fulfill a refund obligation to a policyholder or applicant in a timely manner.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to fulfill a refund obligation to a policyholder or applicant in a timely manner.

disciplinary_grounds.description: With respect to a surety bail bond agent license, rebating or offering to rebate, or unlawfully dividing or offering to divide, any commission, premium, or fee.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: With respect to a surety bail bond agent license, rebating or offering to rebate, or unlawfully dividing or offering to divide, any commission, premium, or fee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Using a license for the principal purpose of procuring insurance on the property of the licensee, relatives, or associated persons.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Using a license for the principal purpose of procuring, receiving, or forwarding applications for insurance of any kind, other than life, or soliciting, placing, or effecting such insurance directly or indirectly upon or in connection with the property of the licensee or that of relatives, employers, employees, or that for which they or the licensee is an agent, custodian, vendor, bailee, trustee, or payee;

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the case of a business entity, using a life license principally to solicit or place insurance on the lives of the entity's own officers, employees, or shareholders.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of an insurance agent that is a business entity, using a life license for the principal purpose of soliciting or placing insurance on the lives of the business entity's officers, employees, or shareholders

disciplinary_grounds.description: Offering, selling, soliciting, or negotiating insurance for or on behalf of any insurer not authorized to transact business in this state, or a spurious, fictitious, or otherwise impermissible insurer.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Offering, selling, soliciting, or negotiating policies, contracts, agreements, or applications for insurance, or annuities providing fixed, variable, or fixed and variable benefits, or contractual payments, for or on behalf of any insurer or multiple employer welfare arrangement not authorized to transact business in this state

disciplinary_grounds.description: In the case of a nonresident agent, failing to maintain licensure as an insurance agent in the agent's home state for the lines of authority held in this state.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: In the case of a nonresident agent, failing to maintain licensure as an insurance agent in the agent's home state for the lines of authority held in this state;

disciplinary_grounds.description: Knowingly aiding and abetting another person or entity in the violation of any insurance law of this state or the rules adopted under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Knowingly aiding and abetting another person or entity in the violation of any insurance law of this state or the rules adopted under it.

definition_quote.value: "Insurance agent" or "agent" means any person that, in order to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance, is required to be licensed under the laws of this state, including limited lines insurance agents and surplus line brokers.
definition_quote.quote: "Insurance agent" or "agent" means any person that, in order to sell, solicit, or negotiate insurance, is required to be licensed under the laws of this state, including limited lines insurance agents and surplus line brokers.

methods_authorized.quote: "Sell" means to exchange a contract of insurance by any means, for money or its equivalent, on behalf of an insurer. ... "Solicit" means to attempt to sell insurance, or to ask or urge a person to apply for a particular kind of insurance from a particular insurer. ... "Negotiate" means to confer directly with, or offer advice directly to, a purchaser or prospective purchaser of a particular contract of insurance

value: Variable life and variable annuity products
Any other line of authority designated by the superintendent
lines_of_authority.quote: A licensee may be qualified for any of the following lines of authority: (1) Life ... (2) Accident and health ... (3) Property ... (4) Casualty ... (5) Personal lines ... (6) Variable life and variable annuity products ... (7) Credit ... (8) Title ... (9) Surety bail bond ... (10) Portable electronics insurance ... (11) Self-service storage insurance ... (12) Travel insurance ... (13) Any other line of authority designated by the superintendent.

resident_license_available.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a resident insurance agent license to an individual applicant whose home state is Ohio

nonresident_license_available.quote: The superintendent of insurance shall issue a nonresident insurance agent license to an applicant that is a nonresident person upon payment of all applicable fees required under this chapter

preexamination_education_hours.quote: The individual has completed, for each line of authority for which the individual has applied, twenty hours of study in a program of insurance education approved by the superintendent

value: bachelor's or associate's degree in insurance from an accredited institution
professional designation approved by the superintendent
exam_waiver_designations.quote: An individual shall not be permitted to take the examination described in division (A) of this section unless one of the following applies: (a) The individual has earned a bachelor's or associate's degree in insurance from an accredited institution. (b) The individual has earned a professional designation approved by the superintendent.

business_entity_license_available.quote: The superintendent shall issue a resident insurance agent license to a business entity applicant upon submission of a completed application and payment of any applicable fees required under this chapter

designated_licensee_required_for_busines.quote: The applicant has designated a licensed insurance agent who will be responsible for the applicant's compliance with the insurance laws of this state.

temporary_license_available.quote: The superintendent of insurance may issue a temporary insurance agent license to any of the following persons if the superintendent determines that the license is necessary for the servicing of insurance business

temporary_license_max_days.quote: A temporary license issued under division (A) of this section shall remain in force for a period not to exceed one hundred eighty days.

appointment_required_to_represent_insure.quote: An insurance agent shall not act as an agent of an insurer unless the insurance agent is appointed as an agent of the insurer.

appointment_fee.value: Fee set by rule pursuant to division (A) of section 3905.40 of the Revised Code, paid by the insurer for each appointment when issued and for each continuance thereafter.
appointment_fee.quote: Each insurer shall pay to the superintendent a fee pursuant to division (A) of section 3905.40 of the Revised Code for every such appointment when issued and for each continuance thereafter.

appointment_termination_reporting_days.quote: An insurer or authorized representative of an insurer that terminates the appointment, employment, contract, or other insurance business relationship with an insurance agent shall notify the superintendent of insurance, in the manner prescribed by the superintendent, within thirty days after the effective date of the termination.

fiduciary_duty_for_funds.quote: All funds collected for the insurer's account shall be held by the producer, in a fiduciary capacity, in one or more appropriately identified bank accounts

additional_fee_for_commercial_business_a.quote: an agent may charge a consumer a fee if all of the following conditions are met: (1) The fee is disclosed to the consumer in a manner that separately identifies the fee and the premium.

misconduct_reporting_to_department_days.quote: An insurance agent shall provide notice to the superintendent of insurance of any administrative action taken against the agent in another jurisdiction or by another governmental agency having professional, occupational, or financial licensing authority within thirty days after the final disposition of the matter.

manager_exclusive_general_agent_license_.quote: No person shall act as a managing general agent representing an insurer licensed in this state with respect to risks located in this state unless the person is licensed as a managing general agent pursuant to division (C) or (D) of this section.

manager_exclusive_general_agent_license_.value: expires on the last day of February next after its issuance or renewal
manager_exclusive_general_agent_license_.quote: any license issued or renewed pursuant to division (C) or (D) of this section shall expire on the last day of February next after its issuance or renewal.

naic_producer_database_used_for_verifica.quote: To determine an applicant's licensure status and standing in another state, the superintendent of insurance may utilize the producer database maintained by the NAIC or its affiliates or subsidiaries.

home_state_change_application_window_day.quote: If a person licensed as an insurance agent under section 3905.06 of the Revised Code changes the person's home state, the person shall, within thirty days after making that change, file a change of address with the superintendent

lapsed_license_reinstatement_window_days.quote: the individual or business entity is eligible to apply for reinstatement of the license within the twelve-month period following the date by which the license should have been renewed

fingerprint_submission_required.quote: Each applicant shall consent to a criminal record check in accordance with this section and shall submit a full set of fingerprints to the superintendent of insurance for that purpose.
